capabilities: store imported entries in a Journalistic/ folder
launch the import from a sidebar icon
extras: Requires a Journalistic export file to exist before importing; the manifest carries an automated-review disclaimer ('This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.') and the README links contributing guidelines elsewhere.
problem: Journalistic journal entries live outside Obsidian and there is no built-in way to bring an exported journal into a vault.

relations.evidence: This is a plugin to import your Journalistic entries to Obsidian.

summary: File importer that converts a Journalistic journal export into notes stored in a Journalistic/ folder in the vault.
